title: wkchat .lnk shortcut window geometry update -- write WindowOrigin into NT_CONSOLE_PROPS
desc: On wkchat exit (and after window move/resize), locate the .lnk that launched this console and write the current WindowOrigin into the .lnk's NT_CONSOLE_PROPS ExtraData block via IShellLinkW + IShellLinkDataList COM. Result: next double-click on the .lnk reopens the console at the same on-screen position even though .lnk does not store arbitrary RECTs.
steps: [DISCOVERY - PRIMARY] GetStartupInfoW.lpTitle. When Explorer launches a console via .lnk it sets STARTUPINFO.lpTitle to the FULL .lnk path (not the executable name). Read it once at chat startup with P/Invoke STARTUPINFOW_Title struct, validate the path ends with .lnk and exists. Stored in _launchingShortcutPath -- used for all subsequent geometry writebacks. Source: ChatCommand.ShortcutGeometry.cs:58 GetStartupInfoW + :87 si.lpTitle.

[DISCOVERY - FALLBACK] When lpTitle is null/empty (e.g. launched from cmd.exe, not Explorer): scan Desktop + Start Menu folders (CSIDL_DESKTOP, CSIDL_STARTMENU, CSIDL_COMMON_STARTMENU) for any .lnk whose IShellLink Target resolves to wkappbot-core.exe AND WorkingDirectory matches Environment.CurrentDirectory. Walks recursively via EnumerateFiles. Source: ChatCommand.ShortcutGeometry.Search.cs (added commit 011d025b 2026-05-05).

[NT_CONSOLE_PROPS BLOCK] Signature 0xA0000002, attached as IShellLinkDataList ExtraData on .lnk files that target a console. Layout matches the public CONSOLE_FE_PROPS / NT_CONSOLE_PROPS structures (cbSize, dwSignature, wFillAttribute, wPopupFillAttribute, dwScreenBufferSize, dwWindowSize, dwWindowOriginX/Y, ...). Total Marshal.SizeOf MUST equal cbSize so AddDataBlock accepts the write.

[READ EXISTING] var dataList = (IShellLinkDataList)link; hr = dataList.CopyDataBlock(NT_CONSOLE_PROPS_SIG_INT, out blockPtr). If found, Marshal.PtrToStructure<NT_CONSOLE_PROPS>(blockPtr) and modify dwWindowOriginX/Y. If absent, NewDefaultConsoleProps() seeds a sensible default block.

[WRITE BACK] dataList.RemoveDataBlock(NT_CONSOLE_PROPS_SIG_INT) first (you cannot Update an existing block, only Remove+Add). Marshal.StructureToPtr the modified struct, AddDataBlock, then IPersistFile.Save(path, fRemember=true).

[COORDINATE UNIT] dwWindowOriginX/Y in NT_CONSOLE_PROPS is documented as character cells (column,row), NOT pixels. We compute approximate cell coords from the live window pixel rect / current font cell size at save time. Cross-monitor differences in DPI accepted as best-effort.

[SIGNATURE QUIRK] 0xA0000002 fits in 32 bits either way. We expose two constants -- NT_CONSOLE_PROPS_SIG_INT (signed int for IShellLinkDataList COM signatures, marshaled as DWORD/int) and NT_CONSOLE_PROPS_SIG_UINT (uint for the struct dwSignature field). Mixing them silently fails CopyDataBlock with E_FAIL.

[WHEN INVOKED] (1) After SaveParentWindowGeo on WT WM_MOVESIZEEND, (2) on AppDomain.ProcessExit/CancelKeyPress final flush. Both routes call the same UpdateLnkGeometry(path, x, y) helper. Failures logged to stderr but never block chat continuation -- shortcut geometry is a quality-of-life feature.
[AUDIT 2026-06-03] source_refs broken: empty source_refs file entries.

requirements.expect: WT window opens at last saved position; on exit the launching .lnk's NT_CONSOLE_PROPS WindowOrigin matches
console window listed (geometry probe path functional)
